title: Qualify DL560 as Engram's preferred test runner: measure full and focused run times on master and confirm which platform tests must stay on Windows
outcome: Engram knows its real build and test times on DL560 and uses DL560 as its preferred runner, with Windows-only coverage kept on Windows
acceptance: A full launcher run (`node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full`) of clean master on DL560 in ~/github/Engram-runner records per-stage times, total time, pass/fail counts and an equal before/after fingerprint, compared against the same commit's or a recent full gate's time on Central
At least one focused run time on DL560 is recorded (cold and warm build where measured), with the job concurrency that was used
Any Linux-only failure is filed as its own Engram item; the list of Windows-only tests and checks that must stay on a Windows host is written down
The result and the runner split (DL560 preferred for Engram, Mac preferred for TermAl) are reported to Greg
